items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Him and a fellow by the name of Boyt Traynor Adams from Tyler, Texas. There's two arrangements.

ctx.x: I was going to say he was Claiborne, I was going to ask if he was...

Claiborne Williams, from Napoleonville, Louisiana. Claiborne Williams' oldest son. That's George Williams. Well, he arranged and he made first class rake in the Navy band. And he did all the arrangements for the Navy band. Him and a fellow by the name of Boyt Traynor Adams from Tyler, Texas. There's two arrangements. But George was in charge of the band, George Williams.
Harold Dejean was in one of those bands.
